VendorOps-bot: FYI vendor invoice VND-2026-APR-77 posted with EUR currency but PO and contract denominated in USD. amount EUR 45,000. please advise on FX booking and deferred revenue impact.
Hannah: flagged. @Liam can you check contract currency clause? this could affect deferred revenue balances if we revalue.
Liam: contract V-9902 signed in USD. billing team says vendor submitted in EUR by mistake and wants us to pay as EUR. currently AR shows vendor invoice as EUR and AP matched.
Priya: for month-end close we need to decide: (1) rebook invoice in USD (use PO) and reverse EUR booking, or (2) keep EUR booking and run FX revaluation. Which preserves deferred revenue mapping?
Arjun: ops note: vendor provided services delivered over Mar-Apr (two-month service). we recorded deferred expense on receipt. if currency changed, deferred expense GL balances will differ and could create P&L FX noise.
Hannah: quick proposal: align to contract currency. reverse EUR AP and reissue vendor payment in USD. document FX impact. need vendor sign-off.
Liam: vendor insists EUR payment is faster for them. legal checked: contract allows payment in other currencies with FX at invoice date. so both options valid. accounting policy prefers contract currency for recurring accruals.
Priya: policy says vendor invoices in foreign currency should be recorded at spot on invoice date and then revalued at period-end for FX. since invoice already posted in EUR we should: (a) keep EUR booking (b) mark deferred expense in EUR (c) run period-end revaluation JE for AP and deferred expense. Note: deferred revenue for customer billings unaffected unless we invoice customers in USD vs EUR mismatch.
Hannah: confirm: any customer invoices tied to this vendor deliverable? this is a marketplace connectivity fee billed to customers monthly in USD. mismatch could create mismatch between COGS and revenue currency.
Arjun: customers billed USD; so if vendor AP in EUR and we revalue, FX gain/loss will hit COGS timeline mismatch vs USD revenue. auditors will ask why.
Liam: suggest pragmatic approach: rebook vendor in USD to align with revenue and deferred expense, then record a one-time FX adjustment between vendor requested EUR and our USD payment as a separate finance expense (non-operating). reduces recurring FX noise.
Priya: acceptable if vendor agrees to a USD invoice. For month-end we need an interim entry. Option A (rebook): ```DR AP-EUR 45,000 EUR (reversal)
CR AP-USD equivalent (booking)```. Option B (keep EUR and revalue): period-end revaluation JE: ```DR FX Loss/Gain (COGS) X
CR AP-EUR X``` where X is revaluation amount.
Hannah: I'll ask vendor to reissue USD invoice this morning. @VendorOps-bot please flag vendor contact.
VendorOps-bot: vendor contact pinged. ticket VND-ISSUE-832 opened.
Arjun: please also include memo in closepack documenting decision and calculation for auditors. I'll prepare revaluation schedule if we keep EUR.
Priya: I'll prepare provisional JE templates and include them in the close pack. Please attach vendor confirmation.
Hannah: update: vendor agreed to reissue in USD before EOD. we'll proceed with rebooking. Priya, Liam please coordinate JE and reversal.
Liam: will post JE ref JE-2026-04-319 once done and upload schedule: gs://redwood-finance/close/1929001234-vnd-822-rebook.csv
Priya: verified entries after posting, matched GL mapping. closing note: keep policy doc link for FX treatment here: https://finance.redwood/policy/fx-treatment. :white_check_mark:
VendorOps-bot: month-end checklist updated item "vendor currency mispost resolution" completed by Hannah at 1929001306.
